spawnExitCrossCheck.decision: Do not add new game spawn/exit entities from the author icons. Existing 11 spawn candidates and 13 exit candidates already cover both maps; exact per-icon association and any unmatched symbol need client/runtime confirmation.
spawnExitCrossCheck.newAuthorSymbolsInterpretation: Roman-number spawn areas and gray departure symbols are annotation evidence; not all are precise interaction points. Keep research return portals distinct from extraction exits.

containersAndRoutes.suburbs: 箱体、公文包及白色图符像素掩码全同；未发现新增/删除容器证据，不能把新图数量当新箱数量。
containersAndRoutes.janus: 多层容器、公文包和门卡标记移入楼层插图，图上移动不等于世界坐标改变。保留旧点ID与主图坐标；未建立精确对应的标记继续待核。
containersAndRoutes.routes: 彩色楼层出口对应和空中轨道显示是作者绘图信息；未建立新的NavMesh边、传送连接、门禁开放条件或跨层高度。

limitations: 相册10月11日更新时间不证明3.3开服客户端或实局已验证。

KZ-J-12的新图对应未解，不删除、不改为确定刷新或掉落。
所有新幻影是巡逻位置候选，未证明精确游戏实体ID、巡逻轨迹或每局出现。
